# Bid the lines, the ADA hash, and the coats.

> Price a parking lot striping job from stall lines, ADA hash aisles, arrows, coats, and new-layout hours — plus price per stall, the extra a per-stall special hides, and the walk-away number.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
